map.한 = 初声 ㅎ + 中声 ㅏ + 终声 ㄴ；사 = ㅅ+ㅏ（无终声）；랑 =: 한 = initial ㅎ + medial ㅏ + final ㄴ; 사 = ㅅ + ㅏ (no final); 랑 = ㄹ + ㅏ + ㅇ. Each block combines these three elements.
map.谚文音节 = 0xAC00 + 初声序号×588 + 中声序号×28 + 终声序: A Hangul syllable = 0xAC00 + initial index × 588 + medial index × 28 + final index. For example 한 (0xD55C) lets you reverse-derive the three elements, which helps with programmatic decomposition.
map.为什么分初声中声终声？: Why Split Into Initial, Medial and Final?
map.谚文是音素文字，方块由辅音(初)+元音(中)+可选辅音(终)拼成；会拆就能懂任何: Hangul is a featural script, and each block is assembled from a consonant (initial), a vowel (medial) and an optional consonant (final). Being able to decompose a block lets you understand how any unfamiliar syllable is read.
map.终声一定是辅音吗？: Is the Final Always a Consonant?
map.终声(받침)只能是 27 个合法收音之一（含 ㅇ 等），可空；元音不能作终声，双: The final (batchim) can only be one of the 27 valid final sounds (including forms such as ㅇ), and it may be empty. Vowels cannot serve as finals, and double finals are normalized to their representative sound.
